options.name: The Taste of Santa Cruz Charter

services.name: Afternoon Pizza Charter
services.desc: Two-hour afternoon sailing with complimentary pizza, wine, beer on tap and soft drinks while enjoying Monterey Bay views.

services.name: Coastal Sail
services.desc: Two-hour coastal charter with scenic views and two complimentary drink tickets for beer or wine.

services.name: Mother's Day Brunch Charter
services.desc: Morning champagne brunch cruise with pastries, coffee, juice and wildlife viewing aboard the Chardonnay II.

services.name: Brewmaster Sail
services.desc: Two-hour coastal sailing charter with local beers and pizza for guests 21 and over, offering ocean views.

services.name: Sunset Sail

These folks go out of their way to make you feel safe and comfortable during these trying Covid times. I totally felt safe. Then the added fun of just has a great fun crew. We had great weather and water. It also helped of in the distant we whale breaching. Wonderful crew, Our Orthodontic Team s Doctors went out on the sail as a team-building event. It turned out perfect we had the best time on the water together. I would recommend it for a large or small group. I want to do it again with my family. Highly recommend the sail. Celebrated

services.name: Morning Coastal Sail
services.desc: Two-hour coastal charter with scenic views and two complimentary drink tickets for mimosas, beer or wine.

services.name: Wednesday Night Race Sail
services.desc: Two-hour coastal sailing charter that lets guests race in a regatta while enjoying beer, wine and pizza.

services.name: The Taste of Santa Cruz Charter
services.desc: Two-hour Sunday tasting cruise featuring small bites from local Santa Cruz chefs with complimentary drinks (seasonal May–September).

services.name: Pono Hawaiian Grill Charter
services.desc: Two-hour charter featuring Hawaiian-style pupus and complimentary drinks from Pono Hawaiian Kitchen & Tap while cruising the Santa Cruz coastline.

services.name: Winemaker Sail
services.desc: Two-hour coastal sailing charter with a friendly regatta, beer, wine and pizza for guests.

services.name: Terrific Tuesdays
services.desc: Turn your Tuesday into a midweek escape with a two-hour afternoon sail!

services.desc: Fireworks Charter Duration 2hr About Enjoy fresh pizza from Upper Crust, red and white wine, beer on tap, and soft drinks while you observe the beautiful annual Monte Foundation Fireworks

gap: Your booking secures your seat. All sails are tentative and confirmed 24 hours prior via email, weather permitting. We do not cancel for low wind or fog. Full refunds are available with 48-hour notice (or 1 week for groups of 5+). Operator cancellations due to weather or unforeseen circumstances are fully refunded. No-shows are charged in full. Contact us by phone for cancellations or questions.
blurb: Experience 70ft of luxury sailing with all new public charters and delicious additions, making the Chardonnay II Monterey Bay’s ultimate sailing experience. Feel the sun on your skin, the wind in your hair, and the thrill of discovering Monterey Bay’s marine wonders in pure luxury. Enjoy refreshing beverages and add some extra flavor to your experience with a delectable grab-and-go meal
